target: Final Fig4 fields at23.8V for Control,Cylinder,Slanted; same corrected material and calibrated avalanche parameters as Fig7.

geometries.Slanted: D=80 nm nominal, Fig.7 fabricated PT surrogate; SEM reports about 77 nm

assumptions.grading: eight-step linear band edge/epsilon/DOS interpolation; no installed AlInGaAs parameter file, so active transport parameters provided explicitly
assumptions.grading_band_edges: Aligned to actual installed endpoints at300K: Eg=0.737256670491→1.48159457143eV; chi=4.63228231475→4.27110142857eV. Eight midpoint layers. No response fitting.
assumptions.electrical_passive_stack: truncate at 300 nm SU8 below epi, electrically floating SOI excluded; outer dielectric Neumann boundary

avalanche_reference.note: local model; thin-layer dead-space not resolved. Not yet validated for this device.

staging: All current Field nodes include avalanche. Previous AV-off and band-inconsistent diagnostic versions are in backups.

current_geometry_normalization.rule: dark PT = PC-area*PT-strip density + remainder*control-strip density; photocurrent = illuminated-area*(light-dark strip current density); uniform effective spot assumption, no fitted output multiplier

numerical_revision: Unified Recombination block activates avalanche verified in native output; n0=p0=1e12 consistently for HFS and avalanche density interpolation; SUPER 80-bit.
transport_staging: First compare AV-off collection and literature local-avalanche dark sweep. Same doping, lifetimes and surface model for all geometries. Resistor=1e7 ohm um is a numerical load line; curves use actual inner contact voltage.
optical_scenario: zero in-plane projected angle for all three wavelength/geometry cases; experiment tilt 10 degrees with unspecified azimuth, full 3D tilt not represented
optical_normalization: native EMW incident reference power and 84.949 um2 uniform-equivalent spot, no empirical output multiplier
avalanche_regularization: GradQuasiFermi to ElectricField interpolation n0=p0=1e8 in HFS and avalanche; no ionization-coefficient change

avalanche_calibration.ionization_model: vanOverstraeten local InAlAs, literature a,b baseline
avalanche_calibration.rule: Scale both electron/hole exponential field parameters by the same factor, estimated from field needed at 24 V divided by raw ionization threshold field. This calibrates the model, not output current. PT breakdown and all optical responsivities are unfit validation targets.

unit_gain_reference: AV-off collection reference at 23.8 V, matching Fig4 bias. The paper does not specify the M=1 extraction bias. All other physical parameters and normalizations unchanged. Separate 20-V scans retained to quantify reference-bias dependence; not blended into 23.8-V curves.
caveat: 2D three slots and area tiling; missing epitaxy/interface/lifetime inputs. Not a claim of 3D quantitative reproduction.
band_alignment_correction: Earlier assumed grade endpoints were inconsistent with actual vendor endpoint affinities, causing an extra0.16eV entry step and0.19eV exit discontinuity. Corrected before final delivery; all electrical cases recomputed with one common parameter file.
